packs.title: How To Play
packs.author: Age of Dragons
packs.description: Five short lessons: gather and build, climb the ages, find your opponent, tame a dragon, then survive a real duel.

packs.title: How To Play (Dummy)
packs.author: Age of Dragons
packs.description: A test copy of How To Play, published as optional content so the download path can be exercised end to end on a device. Not new content.

packs.title: PlatoSample
packs.author: Age of Dragons
packs.description: A feature demo: see what cliffs and plateaus look like, in the map editor and in a match. Fully playable as a two-player map, but it is here to show the terrain off.

packs.title: Game art
packs.author: Age of Dragons
packs.description: Every unit, building, terrain and prop in the game. Without it Age of Dragons draws coloured placeholder shapes -- it runs, but nothing looks like what it is.

packs.title: Player colours
packs.author: Age of Dragons
packs.description: Tinted art for all eight player colours. Without it every unit shows in its base colours and you tell armies apart by position rather than by sight.
